处理大图会卡吗？: Will large images slow it down?
在浏览器本地用 Canvas 完成，图越大越占内存；建议先缩到合适尺寸再处理，数: Processing happens locally in your browser using Canvas. Larger images use more memory, so resize them first — nothing is uploaded.
两种色对比度不够会提示吗？: Will it warn me if two colors lack contrast?
会按 WCAG 算出对比度值与等级，未达标会标红提醒，便于及时换色或调深。: It computes the contrast ratio and WCAG level, flagging anything below the threshold in red so you can swap or darken the color straight away.
只改变一个输入变量重新运行，观察输出变化是否符合工具说明和业务常识。: Re-run with a single input changed and check whether the output shift matches the tool's documentation and common sense.

结果可以直接用于正式业务吗？: Can the result be used directly in official work?
不建议直接使用，正式业务应结合原始凭据、适用规则和人工复核。: Not directly. For official work, combine it with the source records, the applicable rules and human review.
如何复核结果？: How should I verify the result?
固定其余输入，只改变一个变量，并用独立公式或已知样例对照。: Hold the other inputs fixed, change just one variable, and cross-check against an independent formula or a known example.
